## Type

- [ ] Feature (`feature/*` → `develop`)

- [ ] Hotfix for production (`hotfix/*` → `main`, then back into `develop`)
- [ ] Release (`release/*` → `main`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or real customer data
- [ ] Payment, booking or ticket logic changes have tests
- [ ] Demo-only code stays behind the demo adapter
